Portuguese turns are team-written (the dataset has no Portuguese).

## PROJECTION — not a measurement
Assumptions: all text-channel Transaccional contacts are in scope for this workflow (upper bound); the live model's SAR on held-out synthetic cases transfers to production traffic (unverified); no phone channel (voice needs STT; not built).
Measured text-channel Transaccional contacts/month ≈ 1,005. Using this run's SAR (0.97) ⇒ ≈ 976 contacts/month and ≈ 59.9 agent-hours/month, each skipping a measured ~120s queue wait. This SAR is a live model's on held-out synthetic cases; production traffic may differ. Not a production measurement.

ROI per resolution (model costs measured in this run; loaded contact-center agent cost per hour, assumed (not in the data): 5, 10 and 20 USD; every text contact is sent to the model once per turn (cost per attempted case)). Model cost per safe resolution: USD 0.0034.
